capabilities: Sync saved items and wiki topics from Stashwise into vault notes
Search the Stashwise library and insert links or quotes at the cursor
Write back notes typed under a synced item to Stashwise
Save the current note or a selected URL to Stashwise
Configure sync interval, target folder and deletion handling
extras: Stores an unencrypted access token in the vault plugin folder, which travels with vault sync services; disconnecting revokes it server-side. The plugin refuses to write to synced notes whose ownership markers are missing. Free plan of the Stashwise service is supported. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it to put the Stashwise library and wiki into the vault where the user already thinks, and to make a phone-only capture loop with no laptop step.
problem: Content you save and read on your phone stays inside a separate app, so its summaries and topics can't be searched, linked or built on inside the vault.

relations.evidence: sort and query them with Dataview or Obsidian's own search

requires.name: Stashwise mobile app for one-tap connect and share-sheet capture

summary: Integration that syncs your Stashwise library of saved videos, posts and articles into vault notes with summaries, takeaways and wiki topics.
